tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: topping:page-0127 ↗ topping-ch10-hamilton-ivey-theorem 1. ch10:2.2\group positive-ricci-three-manifolds

For a Ricci flow on a closed three-dimensional manifold, every blow-up limit \[ (\mathcal{M},g_i(t),p_i)\longrightarrow (\mathcal{N},\hat g(t),p_\infty ) \] obtained as in Theorem topping-ch8-blow-up-singularities has weakly positive sectional curvature on $(\mathcal{N},\hat g(t))$ for all $t\in (-\infty ,b)$.
